title: Decoder floors, case (b): nine terms outside col M (P112 ≥ 64, #968 P104 ≥ 56; no κ claim)
head: 2d51aad701585343483114fff8bd6ff755e3ed3a
body:
**Status: research note with an exact finite enumeration (not a SAT/DRAT proof). No κ claim, no supplier word.** Only `research/nine-term-outside-colspace/` is added; nothing existing is changed.

## What this proves (scope is the claim)

Model of #2338 / #2277 / #1224: `N = Σ_{j≤m} p_j q_jᵀ` exact for the masked P112 / P104 pattern (zero on orthogonal pairs, nonzero diagonal), arbitrary factors over a field of characteristic 0, cost `Σ_j rank_F2 B[R_j, A_j]`.

* **P112: cost ≥ 64** and **P104 (#968's unit, `F1 = H4`, only): cost ≥ 56** for every decoder with **`m = 9`**, a **rank-8 realisation** (`rank N = 8`), and **exactly one factor outside `col M`** ("case (b)" of #2338's `m = 9` trichotomy; the one-sided nine-term decoders of #1224), **dense `B`**, hence every fitting `B` of F2-rank ≤ 9 (Theorem R of #2338).
* The result relies on #2338 (our own PR, open and ready): Theorem P, Theorem R, and "≤ 8 paid terms ⇒ ≥ 64 / ≥ 56".
* Realisation-free: only the support-propagation lemma (valid in every rank-8 realisation) and the reductions are used; the rigidity PRs (#1212, #1815) are not needed.
* Method: the lift `κ` of the outside factor is free (Lemma 2.1, PROVEN), which reduces the cost count to exact class-level accounting `Σσ_j ≥ 9` over the 511 label classes. Exact enumeration: no big term (counting); ≥ 2 big terms (41 configurations → 0 on P112, 701 → 0 on P104); one big term with row deficiency `d₀ = 2, …, 8` (residues 8, 1, 17, 0, 0, 0, 0, all killed by the support filter).

## Not covered (stated up front)

* **Case (c): square decoders of a RANK-9 realisation.** This contains every nine-term masked **co-star** decoder (D1267, philippeVV; #2338 shows these are case (c)) and the A2 family. Nothing here bears on the co-star programme.
* `m ≥ 10` (one- and two-sided); `B` of rank ≥ 10; other punctured units.
* Not DRAT-logged: the enumeration is exact Python on finite data, re-runnable, but not proof-checked by a solver.

## Labels (every step is in the README)

PROVEN: Lemma 2.1 (free lift), the accounting `Σσ_j ≥ 9`, the "no big term" case, the `d₀ = 7, 8` reduction. CHECKED (exact enumeration): the ≥ 2-big census, `d₀ = 2, 3, 4, 7, 8`, all of P104. **CHECKED-INDEPENDENTLY** (separate re-implementation by a different session, exact agreement): `d₀ = 5, 6` only (`evidence/helper/`). **Not independently re-implemented:** `d₀ = 2, 3, 4, 7, 8`, the ≥ 2-big census, P104. A separate reviewer run found one incompleteness (repeated extra classes were forbidden), fixed in `cnt7/8/9`, everything re-run, residues unchanged. The exact-rank formula (IDEAL Thm 3 / BIGTHEORY Thm A) is proved in the README (3 lines) and spot-checked on 2,974 + 2,973 random blocks, 0 mismatches; the reductions (free-term absorption, merge lemma) are inlined; the geometric inputs (frames, survivors, survivor-pair ranks, 7-cliques) are re-computed by `checks/inputs_check.py`.

## Verification

`bash research/nine-term-outside-colspace/verify.sh /fresh/dir` (Python ≥ 3.11, `numpy`, `networkx`; one core; no SAT). On a fresh `git archive` export (default mode, single process, venv Python 3.14, numpy 2.5, networkx 3.7, on a heavily loaded machine): **92 PASS, 0 FAIL**, 839 s wall (12.0 min user CPU).

**What `verify.sh` re-runs:** the geometric inputs on both units; the exact-rank formula spot check; regeneration of orbits / cliques / pair census; exact line-for-line replay (vs. the recorded logs) of `cnt4` (`d₀ = 2, 3`), `cnt7`/`cnt8` for `d₀ = 2, 3, 7, 8`; subset replays of the census (P112 orbits 8, 13; P104 orbits 9, 30, 56); `cnt9` / `cnt9b` from the recorded compact census output; the two controls (`ctl8`, `ctlb`).
**RECORDED, not re-run by default:** the full census (P112 44 min, P104 32 min), `d₀ = 4, 5, 6` (`cnt6/7/8`, tens of minutes each), the `cnt9`/`cnt9b` inputs (compact census output `data/lb22_le7_*.json`). The full chain re-runs with `FULL=1` (hours; not run for the transcript). The shipped logs and data are pinned in `MANIFEST.sha256`.

## Overlap

Searched (2026-10-15): "nine-term", "co-star", "masked P112", "outside column", "outside col M", "one-sided nine-term". Closest: #1224 (normal form, no floor), #1191 (one-sided mask rigidity, no cost bound), #1320 (one co-star assignment = case (c)), #1236 (root-star supports), #2385 / #2398 / #2515 (fixed completions, COPY-power). Bodies read, proofs not; no PR body states the case-(b) floor.

Parents: #2338 (open item "factors outside `col M`, `m ≥ 9`"), #2639, #2277 (ours). Cited from their statements: #1633, #1180, #1213, #1224, #1815, #1212 (not used), D1267.
